---
name: vibeschool-regression-learning
description: Turn preventable VibeSchool failures into durable tests, validators, gates or explicit debt records.
---
# Regression Learning
For every preventable material failure, identify the failure class and add the cheapest durable prevention: regression test, contract assertion, validator, lint/preflight rule, CI gate, migration check, observability rule or documented reason automation is impractical. Link the prevention to the root cause. Do not merely document a failure that can be mechanically prevented.
